resources.string: A simple, fast keyboard that works offline. Let’s get you typing.
Find Raabta Keyboard in the Android list and turn it on. Menu names vary by phone.
Ready — Raabta is your selected keyboard.
First, enable Raabta in Android keyboard settings.

Normal typing stays local. There is no analytics, typing history, or AI connection. Voice uses your phone’s speech service and may process audio online unless you choose On-device only. Recording starts only when you tap the microphone. Test fields are cleared when this screen closes.
Tap Shift for one capital. Tap it again or hold it for Caps Lock. Hold Backspace to repeat. Use ?123 and =\< for numbers and symbols. Android’s Back gesture hides the keyboard.
Changes apply when you reopen the keyboard. Sound and vibration respect your phone’s settings; silent mode stays silent. Sounds are off by default. Number row adds a row in letter mode.
English + Urdu voice (Android 14+, provider support required)
Automatic English + Urdu voice requires Android 14+ and a supporting speech provider. Choose English or Urdu separately on this phone.

Tap the keyboard microphone to dictate using your phone’s system speech service. It may send audio to its provider. On-device only is optional and needs Android 12+ with a supported offline language model. If no service is available, enable or update Speech Recognition and Synthesis from Google, then select it in Android voice-input settings. No typed context is sent. Permission alone never starts recording. Voice is disabled in password, private, and non-text fields.
On-device only (requires a supported language model)
Allow microphone access, return to your text field, then tap the keyboard microphone again.
Permission granted. Return to your text field and tap the microphone to start.
Microphone permission was denied. Typing still works. You can allow microphone access in App settings.
Voice is unavailable in password, private, and non-text fields.
No speech service is available. Enable your phone’s speech recognition service, then try again.
The microphone could not capture audio. Check microphone access in Android privacy settings and close other recording apps, then retry.
The speech service could not connect. Check its connection or use its offline language model.
No speech was recognized. Tap the microphone and try again.
The speech service is busy. Try again in a moment.
The selected language is unavailable. Turn off On-device only in Raabta setup, try English, or install a supported language model.
Voice typing timed out. Normal typing is still available.
The speech service could not finish. Tap the microphone to retry.
The text field changed or refused the result. Tap the field and dictate again.
